initiatives.name: Net Zero Bank Ambition 2050 with Financed Emissions Targets
initiatives.summary: Barclays published its Transition Update in July 2025, reiterating its ambition to be a net zero bank by 2050, evolving its approach to focus on working with clients on transition, financing clients' transition, and scaling climate tech while integrating nature and social considerations.

evidence.title: Net Zero Bank Ambition by 2050 and Transition Update
evidence.summary: Barclays published its Transition Update in July 2025, reiterating its ambition to be a net zero bank by 2050, evolving its approach to focus on working with clients on transition, financing clients' transition, and scaling climate tech while integrating nature and social considerations.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we published our Transition Update, reiterated our ambition to be a net zero bank by 2050 and outlined how we continue to deliver against our strategy.

evidence.title: Net zero bank ambition by 2050 with financed emissions targets
evidence.summary: Barclays is committed to aligning financing with Paris Agreement goals, setting emissions reduction targets across Upstream Energy, Power, Steel, Cement, Automotive manufacturing, Aviation, UK Commercial Real Estate, and UK Agriculture portfolios. The bank uses its proprietary BlueTrack methodology to measure and track progress against 2030 targets.
evidence.quote: We are committed to aligning our financing with the goals and timelines of the Paris Agreement, consistent with limiting the increase in global temperatures to 1.5°C... we have set emissions reduction targets for our Upstream Energy, Power, Steel, Cement, Automotive manufacturing, Aviation, UK Commercial Real Estate, UK Agriculture portfolios and convergence point for UK Housing.

evidence.title: Achieved 2025 financed emissions reduction targets
evidence.summary: Barclays successfully achieved its 2025 financed emissions reduction targets for Upstream Energy (15% reduction, cumulative 41% since 2020) and Power (30% intensity reduction, cumulative 35% since 2020). Progress was also reported across Aviation, Automotive, Steel, Cement, UK Agriculture, UK Commercial Real Estate, and UK Housing portfolios.
evidence.quote: We have successfully achieved our 2025 financed emissions reduction targets for both the Upstream Energy and Power portfolios. Upstream Energy We achieved our 2025 target to reduce our absolute financed emissions by 15%.

evidence.title: Net Zero Bank Ambition by 2050
evidence.summary: The Group has set out its ambition to be a net zero bank by 2050, with associated climate change risk assessments integrated into audit and financial reporting processes.
evidence.quote: The Group has set out its ambition to be a net zero bank by 2050. Further information is provided in the Group's Climate and Sustainability report which has been incorporated into the 2025 Annual Report on pages 62-107.

initiatives.name: Three-Year Plan: Simpler, Better, More Balanced Bank
initiatives.summary: Barclays successfully deployed £20bn of risk-weighted assets into its three highest-returning UK businesses since 2024, while keeping Investment Bank RWAs stable for the fourth consecutive year, as part of rebalancing the Group's capital allocation.

evidence.title: Rebalancing RWAs Toward UK High-Return Businesses

evidence.title: Three-Year Plan: Simpler, Better, More Balanced Bank
evidence.summary: In February 2024, Barclays announced a three-year plan to improve operational and financial performance, achieving all 2025 financial targets including RoTE of 11.3% and £700m of gross cost savings, exceeding the £500m target. evidence.title: Financial Crime Elevated to Principal Risk Category
